"
'
Hello,' Said the Stick
" is a
science fiction
short story
by American writer
Michael Swanwick
, published in 2002.  It was nominated for the 2003
Hugo Award for Best Short Story
as well as the 2003 Locus Award.
[
1
]
Plot summary
Set in a distant future where the Earth's ex-colonies have turned the planet into a steampunkish, pseudo-medieval wasteland in order to stop their technological advancement, particularly in weapons, the story follows a foot soldier who is going to join the Iron Duke's army to help him in his siege at Port Morningstar, a town held by the despotic Council of Seven. Along the way he finds a talking stick which convinces him to take it with him.
Author's comments
In a 2017 interview, Swanwick said: "I came up with the idea for
"
'Hello,' Said the Stick" while listening to a friend's reading on a Friday night, started writing it the next morning after breakfast, and got it into the mail at 2:30 that afternoon. No diagrams, no outlines, no sweat. And it placed on the Hugo ballot too! If every story came that easily, I'd be a very happy man."
